# Syed Shareef

> Cloud and AI security architect with 15 years across cybersecurity engineering, architecture, and risk. Sr. Security Solutions Architect at Amazon Web Services advising some of the largest cloud environments in the world. Current focus: threat modeling agentic AI systems and securing LLM applications.

This site (cv.techsheriff.net) is a single-page CV. The full content is plain semantic HTML at the root URL; no JavaScript is required to read any of it.

Career summary: AWS Sr. Security Solutions Architect for Strategic Accounts (2023–present) and previously for FSI & Enterprise (2019–2022), with a product stint as Security Engineer on AWS Control Tower (2022–2023) shipping 220+ policy-as-code controls. Before AWS: cloud security architecture at Slalom Consulting (2017–2019) and information security / operational risk at Citigroup (2013–2017). Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Security Specialty, CISSP-ISSAP, CISSP, CSSLP, Anthropic Claude Certified Associate – Foundations. Education: Executive MBA (Southern Methodist University), B.E. Electrical Engineering (Osmania University). Work authorization: U.S. citizen; no visa sponsorship required.
